headline: High-tech giants rush to arrange syndicated loans for material purchases; ordinary people's mortgage funding squeezed
summary: High-tech companies are raising large syndicated bank loans for equipment purchases, reportedly squeezing ordinary mortgage funding. Some mortgage-linked rates have started from 3%, and some exceed 3.5%.
why: Large corporate borrowing competing for bank capital can tighten credit available to households and lift lending rates in the mortgage market.
